draft.shortGloss: to become dry; to dry out
notes: 乾く is an intransitive verb (something dries by itself: 髪が乾く, hair dries). To say you dry something, use the transitive verb 乾かす (kawakasu: 髪を乾かす, to dry one's hair).
In the set phrase のどがかわく ('throat becomes dry', i.e. to get thirsty), it is usually written 渇く rather than 乾く.
